name: sand-animation-first-person-hand
title_zh: 第一人称沙画镜头，手一推就是一条故事线
tagline_zh: 给参考图或一句话主题，出分镜、沙画素材和可信的手部动作。不用逐帧抠沙粒，手推、抹平、撒沙的物理感它替你算好。
tagline_en: Turn a reference image or story theme into storyboard, sand-style assets, and believable hand gestures. No.
desc_en: Create or adapt high-fidelity first-person sand-animation scenes from reference images or story themes, including story-scene design, sand-style illustration assets, and physically believable hand-driven reveals.
why_zh: 它把沙画表演拆成「手部轨迹 + 沙粒响应」两层，手推的力度和方向直接决定沙怎么流。
why_en: It separates hand trajectory from sand response, so push force and direction drive grain flow—resulting in live-performance.
limit_zh: 只产出分镜脚本、素材描述和手部动作参数，不生成最终渲染视频。需要你接入自己的沙画渲染器或物理引擎。
limit_en: Outputs storyboard, asset specs, and hand-motion parameters only—no final render. Requires your own sand renderer or physics engine; static single.
title_en: First-person sand animation scenes with hand-driven reveals
